description: Host control of trusted app-plugin child webviews. The glob MUST match the webview-label scheme `app::<id>` (spec §6 step 0). Scoped with `webviews` and NO `windows` so it applies only to app-plugin webviews, never the main shell. Deliberately EXCLUDES core:default and the shell permissions: app content (e.g. Audience) gets no host IPC bridge — spec §5 'no host<->app data bridge'. Only the host-side visibility/position/focus commands the embedding layer (plugin_show/plugin_hide/plugin_set_rect) drives are granted.
